evidence.quote: This control prevents changes to bucket policy for the Amazon S3 buckets that AWS Control Tower creates in the log archive account.
This control prevents deletion of Amazon S3 buckets created by AWS Control Tower in the log archive account.
This control prevents changes to encryption for the Amazon S3 buckets that AWS Control Tower creates in the log archive account.
This control prevents changes to logging configuration for the Amazon S3 buckets that AWS Control Tower creates in the log archive account.
This control prevents lifecycle configuration changes for the Amazon S3 buckets that AWS Control Tower creates in the log archive account.
By default, this control is enabled on the **Security OU**.
